address: 94, Section 2, Ren'ai Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, 100, Taiwan
bio: Complete with a courtyard and a high-ceilinged foyer, the interior of this luxurious mansion oozes 1930’s glamour. The menu adds a new twist to elaborate recipes available only to the elite back in the day, and which entail lashings of patience and exceptional skills. Try the roast suckling pig three ways that takes a day to prepare. Yilan speciality goza is deep-fried custard made with minced pork and shrimp. For a sweet finale, try kumquat and mashed taro.
